goal: Harden and clarify AlembicAgent within its own boundary: execute the accepted V1-to-V2 tool-system convergence (RC6 SD-3), decompose the runtime monolith, settle MemoryStore per SD-4 with a schema tripwire, enforce write-strict/read-tolerant edge semantics, and close the worst test floor in the workspace (29 test files vs 214 source files).
nonGoals: No @alembic/core import-path changes (CO1 owns the wave); the 51-reference core-import baseline may only shrink.
No weakening of RC3 boundary configs or demonstrated-failure gates.
No MemoryStore migration to Core (SD-4 keeps the adapter in Agent with a recorded Option-C trigger).
No new agent capabilities or provider integrations.
No cross-repo interface negotiation (interface-alignment demand follows after CO + AO + AG + CKG); no AlembicPlugin edits; no version bumps without user direction.

SD-3 absorption as AG1 and SD-4 absorption into AG2 confirmed or rerouted
User-confirmed silent-to-loud list under the write-strict/read-tolerant posture

AgentRuntime decomposition seam list and AG4 numeric targets fixed

Phase 2: V1 runtime (LightweightRouter and peers) deleted with consumer-scan proof; V2ToolRouterAdapter collapsed; ./tools export retired or repointed
expectedCounts updated deliberately with a demonstrated G5 lint mismatch failure before the update and green after
Coordinated Alembic import-update commit by the Alembic window; Alembic build green
D10 legacy-rewrite markers in AgentInterfaceContract closed out
Before/after public-surface snapshot: 15 exact exports maintained or deliberately amended with boundary-policy update

Full check pipeline green

demands.title: AG3 Failure Semantics And Edge Hardening
demands.purpose: Apply the write-strict/read-tolerant posture: atomic slot accounting, typed memory-write errors, visible degraded reads, bounded inputs, abort recovery per ruling.
requiredEvidence: Atomic slot accounting with a race test proving the concurrency cap holds under contention
MemoryStore.add failures become typed errors handled by the coordinator; negative test for SQLite failure path
Evidence-retrieval failure returns a visibly degraded result with stable diagnostic reason, never silent empty
Tool-arg size bounds and prompt-length validation with stable error codes and negative tests
Abort handling per AG0 ruling implemented and tested (minimum: diagnostic recovery record on abort)
Proxy dispatcher cache eviction; circuit-cooldown race fix; hook-error diagnostics — each with evidence
Provider timeout/retry/circuit behavior preserved (regression proof)
Full check pipeline green

demands.title: AG4 Test And Gate Floor Closure
demands.purpose: Close the worst test floor in the workspace: suites for zero-coverage areas, V2 wiring and terminal execution tests, provider failure fixtures, signature smoke, floor snapshot.
requiredEvidence: New suites for forge, tasks, policies, profiles, coordination with counts per AG0 targets
V2 router/adapter integration tests binding real tool calls; terminal session execution and cancellation tests
Provider failure fixtures: malformed body, mid-stream drop, streaming abort

Alembic downstream build green after ./tools retirement
